Kickass Chocolate Cake I think I modified this recipe from an Internet source too, but I can't find it now.
+ 1 1/2 cups FLOUR + 1 cup SUGAR + 1/2 cup UNSWEETENED COCOA + 1 tablespoon GROUND CLOVES + 1 teaspoon BAKING SODA + 1 teaspoon CAYENNE PEPPER + 1/4 teaspoon SALT
+ 1 cup ALMOND MILK (or COLD WATER)
+ 1/4 cup OIL + 1 tablespoon BALSAMIC VINEGAR

+ 1 tablespoon VANILLA (once I replaced this with ORANGE EXTRACT and added some CINNAMON, and the result was amazing)

Preheat oven to baking temperature.

In a bowl beat together the OIL, SUGAR, SALT, SPICES and COCOA until well-combined. Add the remaining ingredients, and stir until well-combined. Pour into a greased enamel plate or cake dish and bake 20-30 minutes. Don't worry if the batter tastes quite spicy -- it mellows out a lot, when you bake it so that the end result is more
chocolate with a spicy after-taste. Cool.

Then mix the following ingredients together, and pour the resultant icing on top:
+ 1 cup POWDERED SUGAR + 1/2 cup UNSWEETENED COCOA
+ 6 tablespoons COCONUT MILK (or ALMOND MILK or SOY MILK)
